clips.title: The story
paras: You carry Apothecary Johaan’s findings from Brill to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher. The Royal Apothecary Society needs them for its work on the New Plague.

The Royal Apothecary Society answers directly to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and works to concoct a New Plague that can wipe out the living and the Scourge. Its laboratories are scattered across Forsaken territory, so researchers must share their findings to keep their work moving. In Brill, Apothecary Johaan has gathered experimental results for other field researchers. You carry them south to Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

Silverpine Forest is the next frontier of Forsaken expansion and research. Apothecary Renferrel works from the Sepulcher, where he oversees biochemical testing amid threats from Moonrage worgen, rogue humans, and the lingering Scourge. He receives Johaan’s notes from Tirisfal Glades and folds their alchemical findings into his own local experiments, advancing the Society’s design.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas. Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.
Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Follow the roads to the south from Brill. From the Undercity go southwest.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What business do you have with me, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research. With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades. Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.
But you must excuse my rambling. Extend your stay in Silverpine, friend. We could use an able bodied adventurer like you around here.
